title: Chicken Thighs With Creamy Dijon Sauce
description:
Pan seared and crispy Chicken Thighs in a smooth and creamy garlic Dijon sauce with Bacon pieces and Spinach! SO EASY and deliciously low carb! Have dinner on the table in less than 20 minutes! Good with roasted or mashed potatoes, or noodles, to soak up all the wonderful sauce.
This is also very good with cross-sectional slices of Pork Tenderloin.
ingredients: ½ teaspoon seasoning salt (or regular salt)
1 small onion or big shallot, diced
½ teaspoon each of dried thyme and dried rosemary
¾ cup half and half (thickened cream or heavy cream)
¼ teaspoon chicken bouillon powder (substitute with salt or stock powder)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, to taste
directions: Season chicken with seasoning salt and pepper.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken until crispy and cooked through (about 3-5 minutes each side, depending on thickness). Transfer to a plate; set aside.
To the same pan or skillet, add the bacon and fry until crispy. Transfer to plate, set aside. Drain some of the bacon fat, leaving about 2 tablespoons.
Heat butter in the pan and sauté onion until transparent. Sauté garlic, parsley, thyme and rosemary for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add in the white wine to deglaze the pan while scraping up any bits from the bottom of the pan; simmer for 3-4 minutes or until wine has reduced by half.
Pour in cream and Dijon, mix thoroughly and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and cook gently for a further minute to allow the sauce to thicken.
Add the Parmesan and allow to melt through the sauce. Season with bullion powder and pepper, to taste.
Return chicken to the skillet. Add the spinach and allow to wilt. Top with the crispy bacon. Sprinkle with extra herbs if desired. Serve immediately.
